# Purpose
This header file defines a seccomp BPF policy for the `fd_gossvf_tile` component and is generated by `generate_filters.py`, so it must not be edited by hand. It includes Linux seccomp and BPF headers, selects the target architecture with `ARCH_NR`, and sets the instruction count for the filter program. The [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_gossvf_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_gossvf_tile>) function fills a `sock_filter` array with rules that allow only `write` and `fsync` system calls when they use the expected file descriptor, and it kills the process for any other system call or invalid argument. This file is used at runtime to install a syscall filter that limits the process to the exact kernel calls needed for logging output.
